data: Una pareja viaja a un país de Europa Oriental para adoptar a un niño, pero la operación no sale según lo previsto. Enseguida se ven inmersos en un ambiente hostil donde reina la corrupción y se trafica con el futuro de los niños y la esperanza de los padres. Así, lo que empezó siendo un sueño acaba convirtiéndose en una pesadilla. (A couple travels to a country in Eastern Europe to adopt a child, but the operation does not go as planned. Soon they find themselves in a hostile environment where corruption is rife and traffics in the future of children and parents hope. Thus, what began as a dream ends up becoming a nightmare.)

A couple travels to a country in Eastern Europe to adopt a child, but the operation does not go as planned. Soon they find themselves in a hostile environment where corruption is rife and traffics in the future of children and parents hope. Thus, what began as a dream ends up becoming a nightmare.
